title: Infrastructure Update
summary: We are updating the queueing mechanism of the Langdock platform. While this should not have an impact on the availability of the platform, there could occur some minor interruptions when uploading or importing documents.
body_markdown: We are updating the queueing mechanism of the Langdock platform. While this should not have an impact on the availability of the platform, there could occur some minor interruptions when uploading or importing documents.
